title: dinebra scabra
intro: Dinebra scabra, commonly known as Indian dune grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial plant native to India and Southeast Asia, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is known to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Dinebra scabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
